beats.name: Story Beat 1: The Illusion of a Plan

cards.text: Open on Alex laying out the grocery strategy and trying to get organized.
Cut straight to Alex declaring the supermarket to be the peak travel experience and the epitome of tourism.
Follow with Alex warning that total chaos is about to happen in the aisles.
Medium pace setting up the dialogue.
Burned-in English subtitles across all Greek dialogue.

beats.name: Story Beat 2: The Fast-Paced Basket Frenzy

cards.text: Quick cut grabbing instant coffee jars.
Snatching cookies off the shelf.
Tossing pre-mixed gin and tonic bottles into the cart.
Grabbing cheap two-euro wine.
Fast 1–2 second cuts synced to rhythmic background percussion.
Subtitles highlight item names and excited reactions.
Alex calls Ioanna over to inspect the pickle shelf.
Ioanna complains about the jar size and insists on getting the small one.
Alex ignores the request and decides to grab two large jars instead.
Normal conversational pacing allowing the comedic dialogue between Alex and Ioanna to breathe.
Full English subtitles.

beats.name: Story Beat 4: Final Rush & Cashier Finish

cards.text: Snap back to high gear with an urgent stop at the snack aisle grabbing bags of chips.
End at the cashier counter wrapping up the shopping spree and paying.
Rapid burst into a final grounded shot at the register.
Outro text cueing the reel theme. Total runtime under 60 seconds.

Set the scene early with the "peak travel experience: the supermarket" line. Midway, slow down for Ioanna's pickle negotiation, then pick the pace back up with "chips, chips, chips" and more throws. End at the cashier.
